essence: The way with no way: when grace has struck firm, one word from the teacher and the immersion is ever-risen — no means required.
Four impossibilities: no nature to attain, nothing to notify, no covering to remove, no one to enter; the means itself impossible.
All is one consciousness-only reality — unmeasured, unbounded, unfaded, uncontrolled, unindicated, unelaborated — autonomous, bliss-dense; I am that, with the universe mirrored in me.
No mantra, worship, meditation, or conduct binds one who sees this steadily.

rasa.justification: Immediate recognition (anupāya) as wonder settling into taught peace: the four impossibilities end in identity.
